observations: The inspected raw player_stats schema contains no expected/xg/xa field.
The inspected shot_events schema contains xg and xgot; their native Opta/FPL provenance has not been established.
The repository explicitly describes seasonal xmetrics as generated SPADL/XGBoost/xPass model outputs. They are not a direct substitute for native match-level FPL expected statistics.
decision: Do not fill FPL-standard xG/xA/xGI/xGC from these model outputs. Keep missing/native/alternative model metrics distinct. A new source or verified shot-metric lineage plus native-FPL comparison is required.
